notes.title: Labyrinth of The Demon King NG+ Update Launches October 27th
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We're extremely happy to announce that the cycle of life and death continues...and with it comes a much anticipated [b]free content update[/b]. This October 27th at 10am ET, delve back into the ominous labyrinth. This free update does not change the labyrinth you've come to know and love, but rather adds an expansive set of new end-game content for once you've finished the game initially. [/p][p]New weapons, enemies, puzzles, mechanics, interactions, and much more await you. Rise once more, ashigaru. [b]Rise![/b] [/p][p]Check out the official announcement here, featuring a first look at NG+:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OQuqJwIXC_o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]For those who have purchased the game elsewhere on consoles, this patch will be coming alongside the prior patches previously available on PC & GOG.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.21 now live!
notes.notes: [p]Hey all, [/p][p]We're pleased to say that the 1.2 patch for Labyrinth of the Demon King is now live on the main branch! This comes following a period of extensive testing, and the prior public access for the update available on a preview branch. [b]For clarity, the preview branch and the main branch are now on the same version.[/b][/p][p]Before we get into the changelog for this version, we'd like to quickly say welcome to all new players of Labyrinth coming in from the Steam Summer Sale, and we appreciate all of the continued support![/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog for version 1.21 (same as prior preview builds):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed aspect ratio reverting to 4:3 during in-game cutscenes while a wide aspect was selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed background showing behind item placement menu in 16:9 or 16:10 aspects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tea making ceremony aspect ratio reverting to 4:3 when 16:9 or 16:10 was selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed irregularity with Nuppeppo boss fight larva behaviour[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra localisation stairs in Nuppeppo boss room and adjusted nav mesh settings[/p][/*][*][p]Changed scroll bar on several widgets to better fit other HUD items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where headshot ranged damage modifier was used for melee weapon headshots[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed kicks being parryable on some weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to toggle HUD[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to toggle crosshair[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to toggle widescreen[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to equip torch instead of lantern if using a 1 handed weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to lower intensity of film Alternatively, if it feels more natural to you to report bugs via Discord, you can find details on how to join our community below.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy, and if you'd like to discuss more about the game, please feel free to join our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/yy7javF"]https://discord.gg/yy7javF[/url][/p][p]Thank you for the continued support for Labyrinth of the Demon King, and stay tuned for more cool updates... notes.title: Patch Notes (Post-Launch 1.01)
notes.notes:
Hi all, as discussed within our initial post-launch update post, a new post-launch patch is now live for Labyrinth of the Demon King. 

Just to reiterate, the changes in this patch are:

[list]
[*] Added framerate cap options (and warning popup that some behaviour may be unpredictable at very high frame rates)
[*] Disabled torch being unequipped when entering an exterior cell
[*] Using the quick equip torch button will now equip the lantern if the player has purchased it
[*] Fixed error where placeholder language names were used instead of official translated terms 
[*] Fixed spelling error in Kings Court Puzzle
[*] Fixed issue where status effects would display “{Amout}” instead of the number for stack amounts for certain languages
[/list]

We hope this improves the experience within the Labyrinth of the Demon King. We're working on other reported issues and are still collecting some initial points of feedback, so stay tuned for more. Thank you for all the support so far!

notes.title: A week after launch, my new favorite gungy, Condemned-style horror-brawler has its first patch and the promise of yokai-punching spiked knuckles on the way
notes.notes: Survival horror dungeon crawler Labyrinth of the Demon King is neck-and-neck with Avowed and Oblivion Remastered as my personal game of the year so far, which I absolutely did not expect when I loaded it up on my Steam Deck before a flight (I ended up playing it all five hours). But even more surprising is that its small development team is already promising new additions just a week after launch... Read more.

notes.title: Release Date Reveal In Top Hat Studios Showcase
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're happy to announce that [b]Labyrinth Of The Demon King[/b] will be participating in the upcoming [b]Top Hat Studios Showcase[/b] on [b]April 22nd[/b]. This showcase, in partnership with The MIX, will be filled with a number of new trailers, exclusive reveals, and more - and among them, we're happy to say that [b]the release date of Labyrinth Of The Demon King will be revealed as well[/b]. We're happy to announce that the game has passed all certifications on all platforms and will be rolling out very soon - the date of which will be announced at this showcase.

Be sure to tune in on April 22nd at 10am PDT / 1pm EDT / 5pm UTC.
